measure: a span of time between two timestamps
gold_sql:
WITH borough_bike_activity AS (
    SELECT
        boro.borough_id,
        boro.borough_name,
        t.bike_id,
        COUNT(*) AS trip_count,
        MIN(t.started_at) AS first_trip_started_at,
        MAX(t.ended_at) AS last_trip_ended_at
    FROM boroughs AS boro
    JOIN stations AS s
        ON s.borough_id = boro.borough_id
    JOIN trips AS t
        ON t.start_station_id = s.station_id
    JOIN bikes AS bk
        ON bk.bike_id = t.bike_id
    WHERE t.ended_at IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY
        boro.borough_id,
        boro.borough_name,
        t.bike_id
    HAVING COUNT(*) >= (
        SELECT AVG(bike_trip_count)
        FROM (
            SELECT
                COUNT(*) AS bike_trip_count
            FROM stations AS s2
            JOIN trips AS t2
                ON t2.start_station_id = s2.station_id
            WHERE s2.borough_id = boro.borough_id
              AND t2.ended_at IS NOT NULL
            GROUP BY t2.bike_id
        )
    )
),
ranked_bikes AS (
    SELECT
        borough_id,
        borough_name,
        bike_id,
        trip_count,
        first_trip_started_at,
        last_trip_ended_at,
        RANK() OVER (
            PARTITION BY borough_id
            ORDER BY trip_count DESC, bike_id
        ) AS bike_rank
    FROM borough_bike_activity
),
top_bikes AS (
    SELECT
        borough_id,
        borough_name,
        bike_id,
        first_trip_started_at,
        last_trip_ended_at
    FROM ranked_bikes
    WHERE bike_rank = 1
)
SELECT
    borough_id,
    borough_name,
    AVG(julianday(last_trip_ended_at) - julianday(first_trip_started_at)) AS avg_top_bike_active_span_days
FROM top_bikes
GROUP BY
    borough_id,
    borough_name
ORDER BY avg_top_bike_active_span_days DESC

gold_sql:
WITH weather_stats AS (
    SELECT
        borough_id,
        COUNT(*) AS weather_days,
        AVG(temp_c_avg) AS avg_temp_c,
        AVG(precip_mm) AS avg_precip_mm,
        MAX(wind_kph) AS max_wind_kph,
        SUM(CASE WHEN precip_mm >= 1.0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS rainy_days
    FROM weather_daily
    GROUP BY borough_id
),
promo_stats AS (
    SELECT
        promo_code,
        julianday(valid_to) - julianday(valid_from) + 1 AS valid_days,
        discount_pct,
        description,
        CASE
            WHEN lower(description) LIKE '%weekend%' THEN 'weekend'
            WHEN lower(description) LIKE '%winter%' THEN 'seasonal'
            WHEN lower(description) LIKE '%peak%' THEN 'peak_hours'
            WHEN lower(description) LIKE '%first ride%' THEN 'acquisition'
            ELSE 'general'
        END AS promo_label
    FROM promos
),
model_stats AS (
    SELECT
        COUNT(*) AS model_count,
        AVG(weight_kg) AS avg_model_weight_kg,
        MAX(weight_kg) AS max_model_weight_kg,
        AVG(CASE WHEN is_electric = 1 THEN battery_wh END) AS avg_electric_battery_wh,
        SUM(CASE WHEN is_electric = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS electric_model_count
    FROM bike_models
)
SELECT
    ws.borough_id AS borough_id,
    ROUND(ms.model_count * 1.0 / ws.weather_days, 6) AS models_per_weather_day,
    ws.weather_days AS weather_day_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ps.promo_code) AS promo_count,
    ROUND(AVG(ps.discount_pct), 2) AS avg_discount_pct,
    ROUND(AVG(ps.valid_days), 2) AS avg_promo_valid_days,
    ROUND(ws.rainy_days * 1.0 / ws.weather_days, 4) AS rainy_day_ratio,
    ROUND(ws.avg_temp_c, 2) AS avg_temp_c,
    ROUND(ws.avg_precip_mm, 2) AS avg_precip_mm,
    ROUND(ws.max_wind_kph, 2) AS max_wind_kph,
    ROUND(ms.avg_model_weight_kg, 2) AS avg_model_weight_kg,
    ROUND(ms.max_model_weight_kg, 2) AS heaviest_model_weight_kg,
    ROUND(ms.avg_electric_battery_wh, 2) AS avg_electric_battery_wh,
    CASE
        WHEN ws.avg_temp_c >= 20 THEN 'warm'
        WHEN ws.avg_temp_c >= 10 THEN 'mild'
        ELSE 'cool'
    END AS temperature_label,
    CASE
        WHEN AVG(ps.discount_pct) >= 50 THEN 'high_discount'
        WHEN AVG(ps.discount_pct) >= 20 THEN 'medium_discount'
        ELSE 'low_discount'
    END AS discount_band_label
FROM weather_stats AS ws
CROSS JOIN promo_stats AS ps
CROSS JOIN model_stats AS ms
GROUP BY
    ws.borough_id,
    ws.weather_days,
    ws.rainy_days,
    ws.avg_temp_c,
    ws.avg_precip_mm,
    ws.max_wind_kph,
    ms.model_count,
    ms.avg_model_weight_kg,
    ms.max_model_weight_kg,
    ms.avg_electric_battery_wh
HAVING ws.weather_days > 0
ORDER BY ws.borough_id

  SELECT
    m.job_id,

    ON btc.bike_id = m.bike_id

    COUNT(*) AS maintenance_job_count

),
cutoff AS (

  FROM issue_type_counts
  ORDER BY maintenance_job_count DESC
  LIMIT 1 OFFSET 2
),
top_issue_types_including_ties AS (
  SELECT
    itc.issue_type,
    itc.maintenance_job_count
  FROM issue_type_counts AS itc
  CROSS JOIN cutoff AS c
  WHERE itc.maintenance_job_count >= c.cutoff_count
),
issue_trip_stats AS (
  SELECT
    mwt.issue_type,
    COUNT(*) AS maintenance_job_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN mwt.trip_count = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS zero_trip_job_count

WITH maintenance_enriched AS (
    SELECT
        t.technician_id,
        t.technician_name,
        m.job_id,
        m.reported_at,
        m.completed_at,
        m.station_id,
        s.borough_id,
        CASE
            WHEN m.completed_at IS NOT NULL
                 AND julianday(m.completed_at) >= julianday(m.reported_at)
            THEN julianday(m.completed_at) - julianday(m.reported_at)
            ELSE NULL
        END AS completion_days
    FROM technicians AS t
    JOIN maintenance AS m
        ON m.technician_id = t.technician_id
    LEFT JOIN stations AS s
        ON s.station_id = m.station_id
),
technician_rollup AS (
    SELECT
        technician_id,
        technician_name,
        COUNT(job_id) AS reported_jobs,
        COUNT(completed_at) AS completed_jobs,
        SUM(CASE WHEN completed_at IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS numerator_completed_jobs,
        SUM(CASE WHEN completion_days IS NOT NULL THEN completion_days ELSE 0 END) AS total_completion_days,
        COUNT(completion_days) AS denominator_completed_jobs_with_valid_days,
        COUNT(DISTINCT station_id) AS distinct_stations_seen,
        COUNT(DISTINCT borough_id) AS distinct_boroughs_seen
    FROM maintenance_enriched
    GROUP BY
        technician_id,
        technician_name
)
SELECT
    technician_id AS technician_id,
    technician_name AS technician_name,
    reported_jobs AS reported_jobs,
    completed_jobs AS completed_jobs,
    ROUND(
        1.0 * numerator_completed_jobs / NULLIF(total_completion_days, 0),
        4
    ) AS completed_jobs_per_completion_day,
    ROUND(
        1.0 * total_completion_days / NULLIF(denominator_completed_jobs_with_valid_days, 0),
        4
    ) AS avg_completion_days_per_completed_job,
    distinct_stations_seen AS distinct_stations_seen,
    distinct_boroughs_seen AS distinct_boroughs_seen
FROM technician_rollup
WHERE reported_jobs > 0
ORDER BY completed_jobs_per_completion_day DESC, completed_jobs DESC, technician_id

    SELECT
        m.job_id,
        m.station_id,
        s.station_name,

survivor_jobs AS (
    SELECT
        r.repair_days
    FROM rainy_station_jobs AS r
    JOIN station_ranked AS sr
        ON sr.station_id = r.station_id
    WHERE sr.repair_time_rank <= 3
)
SELECT
    AVG(repair_days) AS avg_repair_days_top_3_rainy_stations
FROM survivor_jobs

ranked_promos AS (
    SELECT
        pu.*,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            ORDER BY pu.trip_count DESC, pu.promo_code
        ) AS usage_rank

SELECT
    rp.promo_code AS promo_code,
    rp.trip_count AS max_trip_count,
    rp.distinct_member_count AS distinct_member_count,
    ROUND(
        1.0 * rp.distinct_member_count / NULLIF(rp.trip_count, 0),
        4
    ) AS member_to_trip_ratio,
    ROUND(rp.avg_fare_cents, 2) AS avg_fare_cents,
    rp.max_fare_cents AS max_fare_cents,
    rp.first_used_at AS first_used_at,
    rp.last_used_at AS last_used_at,
    rp.promo_label AS promo_label,
    ws.weather_day_count AS weather_day_count,
    ROUND(ws.avg_temp_c, 2) AS overall_avg_temp_c,
    ROUND(ws.max_temp_c - ws.min_temp_c, 2) AS temp_range_c,
    ROUND(ws.avg_precip_mm, 2) AS overall_avg_precip_mm,
    ts.technician_count AS technician_count,
    ROUND(ts.avg_hourly_rate_cents, 2) AS avg_hourly_rate_cents,
    ts.max_hourly_rate_cents AS max_hourly_rate_cents,
    ts.min_hourly_rate_cents AS min_hourly_rate_cents,
    ts.depot_borough_count AS depot_borough_count
FROM ranked_promos rp
CROSS JOIN weather_summary ws
CROSS JOIN technician_summary ts
WHERE rp.usage_rank = 1

measure: a running or cumulative total over an ordering
gold_sql:
WITH active_station_counts AS (
  SELECT
    b.borough_id,
    b.borough_name,
    COUNT(s.station_id) AS active_station_count
  FROM boroughs AS b
  LEFT JOIN stations AS s
    ON s.borough_id = b.borough_id
   AND s.is_active = 1
  GROUP BY
    b.borough_id,
    b.borough_name
),
borough_running AS (
  SELECT
    borough_id,
    borough_name,
    active_station_count,
    SUM(active_station_count) OVER (
      ORDER BY active_station_count DESC, borough_id
      ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
    ) AS running_active_station_count
  FROM active_station_counts
),
cutoff AS (
  SELECT
    running_active_station_count AS cutoff_running_total
  FROM borough_running
  WHERE running_active_station_count >= (
    SELECT COUNT(*) FROM technicians
  )
  ORDER BY running_active_station_count, borough_id
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT
  br.borough_id AS borough_id,
  br.borough_name AS borough_name,
  br.active_station_count AS active_station_count,
  br.running_active_station_count AS running_active_station_count,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM technicians) AS technician_count,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM promos) AS promo_count
FROM borough_running AS br
CROSS JOIN cutoff AS c
WHERE br.running_active_station_count <= c.cutoff_running_total
ORDER BY
  br.active_station_count DESC,
  br.borough_id
